card.name: Just before withdraw-type words
card.fires_on: The word "WITH" split off at the start of WITHDRAWN, WITHDRAWAL or WITHHELD, and linking words like "be" or "is" right before withdrawn or repositioned in needle instructions.

modes.label: WITH inside withdraw words
modes.description: The first piece "WITH" of an all-caps WITHDRAWAL, WITHDRAWN or WITHHELD.
modes.example: NEONATAL OPIOID<< WITH>>DRAWAL SYNDROME See full prescribing

modes.label: Linking word before needle moves
modes.description: "be" or "is" just before a needle or cannula is withdrawn, repositioned or inserted.
modes.example: After injection, the needle<< is>> withdrawn and a small dressing applied.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting pull and withdraw-type words next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say withdraw, either in drug withdrawal terms or in pulling a needle out.
